candidates.name: seeded-determinism-and-replay
candidates.description: Apply the single 32-bit seeded PRNG, its serialized state and the fixed consumption order for shuffles, reward offers, enemy plans and round seeds so seeded runs, saves and browser journeys replay identically.
candidates.reason: Determinism spans ENG-FR-05, RUN-FR-08, DUEL-FR-02 and the seeded Playwright journeys; the ordering, state-travel and no-Math.random rules are fragile, repeated in four places and not covered by any existing package.

candidates.name: versioned-local-persistence
candidates.description: Implement the three versioned Fieldbound localStorage keys with validate-before-use, discard-only-the-affected-key, injectable storage adapters and in-memory fallback when storage is full or unavailable.
candidates.reason: Settings, run save and stats repeat the same versioned-payload contract across SHL-FR-07, RUN-FR-05, RUN-FR-06 and RUN-FR-07, and the narrow-corruption and quota rules are easy to get subtly wrong; no existing package covers project persistence.

candidates.name: portrait-first-board-and-accessibility
candidates.description: Build and verify the 375px-to-1080px board layout, 44px targets, glyph-plus-label element cues, focus trapping, polite live announcements and the reduced-motion contract shared by the shell and the release checks.
candidates.reason: The same responsive and accessibility invariants are built in SHL-02, SHL-04 and SHL-07 and asserted again in REL-04, with project-specific traps such as hand-row scrolling versus page scroll; no existing package encodes them.

candidates.name: placeholder-asset-manifest
candidates.description: Generate deterministic SVG placeholders, publish the 41-entry asset manifest with spec metadata, resolve files through a base-URL-aware loader and keep the documented swap contract intact.
candidates.reason: CNT-FR-05 and CNT-FR-06, the shell asset rendering and the build audits all depend on one id-to-file mapping with byte-stable regeneration; the rules are procedural and repeated across features rather than one-off.

candidates.name: static-build-origin-audit
candidates.description: Produce and audit the GitHub Pages subpath build with build-only CSP injection, zero cross-origin requests after load, a 307200-byte gzip budget and committed CI and Pages workflows.
candidates.reason: The base-path, CSP-injection and origin constraints originate in ENG-00 and VIS-SEC-01 and are then proved by REL-05 and REL-06; the sequence fails silently when applied from memory, so it warrants a reusable checklist.

candidates.name: balance-tuning
candidates.description: Tune card, health, heal and enemy numbers from self-play and playtest evidence.
candidates.reason: VIS-CON-07 freezes every number for v1 and section 13 defers tuning to a documented follow-up, so encoding a tuning process now would contradict the current scope.

candidates.name: human-release-review
candidates.description: Perform the single human release review of both journeys and record readability, privacy and runtime observations.
candidates.reason: REL-HR-1 is a human-review task with no model owner; packaging it as a skill would invite an agent to fabricate the sign-off that the task exists to keep human.
